mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MO_NUM numeric(12) NOT NULL, MO_ACCEPTTIME character varying(14), MO_MODIFIED character varying(14), MO_NUMBER character varying(20), MO_SENDER character varying(20), MO_ORGADDR character varying(20), MO_MSG character varying(160), MO_SN numeric(12), MO_NET character varying(10), MO_STATUS character varying(1), MO_REPLY_DATE character varying(14), MO_REPLY_MSG character varying(160), CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY ( MO_NUM ) )

CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MO_NUMBER character varying(20), ALARM_YN character varying(1) DEFAULT'N', ALARM_DAY_TIME character varying(20) DEFAULT'09:00~18:00', ALARM_DAY_RECEIVERS character varying(200), ALARM_DAY_SENDER character varying(20), ALARM_NIGHT_TIME character varying(20) DEFAULT'18:00~09:00', ALARM_NIGHT_RECEIVERS character varying(200), ALARM_NIGHT_SENDER character varying(20), ALARM_MSG character varying(160), AUTO_REPLY_YN character varying(1) DEFAULT'N', AUTO_REPLY_MSG character varying(160) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( MO_NUM, MO_ACCEPTTIME, MO_MODIFIED, MO_NUMBER, MO_SENDER, MO_ORGADDR, MO_MSG, MO_SN, MO_STATUS, MO_NET ) VALUES ( CAST(NEXTVAL('${tableName}_SEQ') AS numeric), #{parameter.receiveDate}, TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{parameter.moNumber}, #{parameter.callback}, #{parameter.sender}, #{parameter.message}, CAST(#{parameter.moKey} AS numeric), #{parameter.status}, #{parameter.telco} )
